title: stelis viridiflava
intro: Stelis viridiflava, commonly known as Green-flowered Stelis, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Stelis viridiflava include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and hepatoprotective activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
